body:
## Summary

Completes the Swing Highs & Lows feature by resolving two confirmed defects identified during independent technical audit:
1. Fixes timeframe trend desynchronisation in `function_panel.js`, where the Market Structure panel displayed the 1H engine bias on 15M / 4H charts because it read `dashboard.market_state.trend` rather than `viewed.evidence.trend`.
2. Fixes a CSS grid layout defect in `styles.css` (`.cfp-facts`), where long bias strings forced word breaking and character collision (`CurrenBullish · higher highs and higher lows bias`).
3. Enhances `chart_functions.js` to export `chronologicalSwingConnectors` and support chronological zigzag formatting, while maintaining full backward compatibility with kind-separated boundary connectors.

Presentation-only changes. No detectors, qualification rules, trade planning, thresholds, databases, or trading logic are touched.

## Files changed

- `src/trading_assistant/web/static/js/function_panel.js` — in `swingsModel`, bind to `evidence.trend` first (which represents the viewed timeframe) before falling back to `marketState.trend`.
- `src/trading_assistant/web/static/styles.css` — update `.cfp-facts` grid columns to `minmax(90px, 115px) minmax(0, 1fr)` and set `overflow-wrap: normal` on the label to eliminate text squishing and character collision.
- `src/trading_assistant/web/static/js/chart_functions.js` — export `chronologicalSwingConnectors` to support structural market progression (zigzag) and add `format` parameter to `swingConnectors`.
- `tests/frontend/function-panel.test.mjs` — added 3 unit tests verifying timeframe trend preference, marketState fallback, and missing trend handling.
- `tests/frontend/chart-functions.test.mjs` — added unit test verifying chronological ordering and major-only filtering.

## Tests run (exact commands and results)

- JavaScript: `npm test` → 429 tests, 429 passed, 0 failed (37 test suites, 18.4s)
- Python targeted: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_chart_evidence.py tests/test_market_structure.py tests/test_market_structure_service.py tests/test_web_frontend_contract.py -v` → 78 passed in 9.19s
- Python full suite: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` → 1182 passed, 1 xfailed (the documented decision-invariance xfail is untouched)
- Lint: `ruff check --isolated --select E4,E7,E9,F src tests` → 0 new findings (15 pre-existing repository debt untouched)

## Safety checklist (answer every box)

- [x] No trading-strategy changes (presentation and UI evidence binding only)
- [x] No access to credentials, API keys, or production databases
- [x] No historical backfill and no modification of existing journal / ledger / paper records
- [x] No real-money trading path added or changed
- [x] The documented xfail in `tests/test_decision_invariance.py` is untouched
- [x] CI (GitHub-hosted, no secrets) passes on this PR
- [x] No automatic merges or deployments introduced

## What this does NOT do

- Does not modify detector algorithms in `src/trading_assistant/market_structure/` (which were independently verified as mathematically sound and causal).
- Does not modify Chart Patterns (`pattern_view.js`, `patternsModel`) or Support & Resistance (`zone-position.js`), ensuring zero conflict with PR #65 and PR #66.
- Does not alter order placement or introduce live execution.
